security.title: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
security.summary: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

security.title: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
security.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

security.title: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
security.summary: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

security.title: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
security.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

security.title: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
security.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

security.title: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
security.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

security.title: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
security.summary: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

security.title: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
security.summary: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. security.title: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
security.summary: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

security.title: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
security.summary: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

security.title: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
security.summary: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

security.title: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
security.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

security.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
security.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

security.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
security.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.
